EvalHarnessConfig.description:
Configuration for the agent evaluation harness (`[eval]`), surfaced via the
`zeroclaw eval` command. Distinct from `[agent.eval]`, which is the in-loop
response-quality scorer.

mode.description: Default execution mode (`replay` or `live`) used when `--mode` is omitted.

suite_dir.description: Default directory of `*.json` trace fixtures used when `--suite` is omitted.
